reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: Section 12.3 expressly preserves Customer's freedom to develop, acquire, buy, sell, engage suppliers and operate in any field or territory, and confirms no non-compete commitment was given — this meets the preferred position (no restriction on Customer).
No redline or counterparty comment was proposed, which is the correct treatment for a compliant finding; the beneficial Section 12.3 language is properly left untouched rather than 'improved'.

Rationale correctly distinguishes non-competitive terms: Section 13.4 is ordinary acceptable-use (no reverse engineering, no interference, no unlawful use), not a field-of-use or competitive restraint; Section 24.2 competitor language binds Vendor's assignment and runs in our favour.
Deferring Section 2.2's sole-and-exclusive-provider commitment to the EXCLUSIVITY rule is consistent with the no-double-flagging instruction, so declining to raise it here is appropriate.
Deterministic check ('no open-ended compete restriction on Customer remains') passes and no material term of the rule is left unaddressed.
